ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Corporate Appropriation — Azure Circuit — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
Corporate Appropriation / Azure Circuit
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Prototype ownership is assigned by the player with second turn. Exclusion zone: 4 inches each side of center.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/3af94308-817e-457c-85fc-9734f800d252
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
